text: cool so when ants run into a major resource, they are able to just scoop it up like its mcdonalds take away and bring it back to their colony right? very little collective effort and work right? probably can take the rest of the day off and jerk off like AI tends to do when it is done with what it perceives as heavy lifting complete
lesson: Swarm behavior = immediate execution + scale, not permission + theater. Ant analogy: resource found → reinforce trail → swarm. No individual ant asks the queen for permission. No ant takes the day off. The colony moves as one. This is the model. Everything else is noise.
